stories.headline: Domtar to halt sawing at its Baie-Comeau mill November 20
stories.body: Domtar told Quebec media that Scierie des Outardes will stop sawing on November 20 for an indefinite period. The company cited uncertainty over fibre supply and harvest planning, high fibre and freight costs, U.S. duties and weak lumber prices.

featuredResource.title: LiVT — Log in Vermont
featuredResource.description: LiVT is a browser app for evaluating logging-business financial results. Enter overhead, equipment, labor, production and revenue to examine profit or loss for a week or job.
